purpose: Turn the accepted Settings & Location personalization boundary into one validated alert-sound/volume and glass-intensity outcome with local auto-save, invalid-value preservation and a production-card live preview.
success_outcome: A clean Android build and deterministic isolated evidence prove that accepted sound, volume and glass values validate, auto-save and reload; invalid values retain the last valid settings with inline errors and no modal; the preview live-renders the production Today card or 24 °C fallback without network access; and Timer & Alert preserves visual overdue behavior while Android audio policy remains authoritative.
anti_goals: Do not implement FT-007 completion-time overdue presentation, alert scheduling, ramp or dismissal; Timer & Alert only consumes this validated projection.

Do not implement FT-002 weather normalization/cache/history, read Weather Context storage directly or add a Settings & Location -> Weather Context edge; Main Display supplies the existing Today read or the accepted fallback.
Do not add extra Settings controls, modal errors, realtime blur/refraction/heavy visual effects, backend/cloud/accounts, Google Services, event infrastructure, new dependencies or reboot recovery.
Do not change the accepted API-key/local-secret boundary, place secrets in source/logs/fixtures/evidence or claim runtime evidence during planning.

forbidden_scope: FT-001 clock/fullscreen shell, FT-002 weather normalization/cache/history, FT-003/FT-004 forecast sessions and FT-005/FT-006/FT-007 timer lifecycle, overdue presentation and completion alert behavior

constraints: Settings & Location is the sole mutable owner of validated alert sound, app alert volume and glass intensity; valid values auto-save and invalid values remain unsaved while preserving the last valid value with the owning inline error.

Main Display composes the production Today card and Settings preview from the existing validated Settings projection and its existing Weather Context read or 24 °C fallback; no private-storage bypass or Settings -> Weather Context edge is authorized.

Timer & Alert reads the validated sound/volume projection and never writes Settings; app alert volume 0 suppresses only app-alert sound, while visual overdue state and Android silent/DND policy remain independent.
The preview uses the shared static pseudo-glass/weather-card contract, updates during the gesture, makes no network request and introduces no extra Settings surface or modal error.
No new module, public contract, graph edge, dependency, event boundary, backend, Google Services, secret-bearing artifact or unaccepted product scope is authorized.
